name: How soon after storm damage should I address drywall replacement?

mainEntity.name: How soon after storm damage should I address drywall replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is critical to address storm-damaged drywall as quickly as possible, ideally within 24-48 hours, to prevent further damage and inhibit mold growth. Water-saturated drywall creates an ideal environment for mold spores to develop. Prompt action minimizes the scope of repairs, reduces potential health risks, and can help streamline your insurance claim process. Contacting a professional immediately allows for proper assessment and mitigation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Address storm-damaged drywall within 24-48 hours to prevent mold growth and further structural issues. Prompt action is crucial for health and repair scope.
